question: Who among the following has assumed the charge of Director General of the Armed Forces Medical Services on 1 January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajat Datta.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Rajat Datta** has assumed the charge of Director-General of the Armed Forces Medical Services on 1 January 2021.
 
• He is the senior-most military doctor in the** Indian Armed forces.**
 
• Before becoming India's senior-most military doctor, Admiral Datta led the **navy's medical wing.**
 
• He previously served as the director of the Army's flagship Research and Referral Hospital.
 
• He is a graduate of the Armed Forces Medical College in Pune, where he received his MBBS in 1982 and was commissioned into the AMC on December 27, 1982.
 
• From **February 1, 2020,** the Flag Officer will serve as Honorary Surgeon to the President of India.
 
• He is a member of the Society of Cardiovascular Angiography and Interventions in the United States of America.
 
• He was given the VSM in 2005, SM (D) in 2014, and AVSM in 2017 for his dedication and devotion to the military.
